trend: Classic trial: L-theanine + caffeine improved task switching, but people didn't feel more alert (Giesbrecht et al., 2010)
why: Classic-trial shape the team approved on 24 Nov, with an honest twist. Ties to the L-theanine LinkedIn post today.
text:
In a placebo-controlled trial, L-theanine with caffeine helped people switch between tasks more accurately. The odd part: they didn't feel any more alert.

That's the kind of focus we wanted in SILT Mornings. Steady and useful, without the buzz.
